datasets.name: INCLUDE: Indian Lexicon Sign Language Dataset
datasets.reported_split_support: reported benchmark splits; signer-independent support must be verified locally
strengths: directly aligned with isolated Indian Sign Language recognition
sufficient vocabulary scale for first serious benchmark
risks: license must be verified from actual distribution
signer metadata may be insufficient for signer-independent evaluation
official split may be random rather than signer-independent
datasets.initial_use: primary candidate after license and metadata verification

datasets.name: ISL Isolated Word Dataset 40 Words
datasets.reported_split_support: metadata field reported; must verify semantics
strengths: metadata reports provenance, signer, hashes, duration, quality, duplicate status
risks: not a single unified license
derived labels and aliases require manual review
too small for final 100+ sign objective
datasets.initial_use: pipeline sanity-check only after license review

datasets.name: Indian Sign Language Dictionary till January 2024 / Data.gov and re-encodes
datasets.reported_license: reported MIT on one third-party re-encode; original source terms must be checked
risks: very large storage requirement
metadata completeness uncertain
signer-independent evaluation may not be possible
third-party re-encode terms may not fully define original data rights

datasets.name: CISLR: Corpus for Indian Sign Language Recognition
strengths: research paper and baseline context available
risks: access path and license need verification
may not fit initial controlled benchmark phase

datasets.name: ISL-CSLTR Indian Sign Language Dataset
datasets.reported_license: CC BY-SA 4.0 reported on Kaggle page
risks: not primary isolated word recognition data
small sentence count for robust language generation

datasets.name: ISL Fingerspelling Dataset
datasets.reported_split_support: standard and signer-independent split files reported
datasets.reported_license: CC BY-NC 4.0 context reported on project page; verify actual dataset card terms
risks: fingerspelling differs from isolated word-sign recognition
non-commercial constraints may apply

datasets.name: IIITA-ROBITA Indian Sign Language Gesture Database
risks: too small for project objective
access requires institutional agreement
controlled background limits real-world relevance

datasets.name: Indian Sign Language Video Dataset
risks: source/provenance from YouTube needs rights review
signer diversity unclear
still signs may bias training if mixed casually
